notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Validation failures raise `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly/errors.py` using the established codes: `invalid_state` for wrong invoice status, `invalid_quantity` for bad quantities, `negative_amount` for negative money. Reuse these codes instead of inventing new ones.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0002] Convert amounts with to_money and ZERO: Wrap raw unit prices with ledgerly.money.to_money before arithmetic and seed sums with ledgerly.money.ZERO, as line_total and invoice_total do in ledgerly/invoice.py.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer inputs: When validating an integer parameter, reject `bool` explicitly (`isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int)`) because `True`/`False` are ints in Python and would otherwise pass quantity checks.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic, as done in `next_renewal` for both `after` and `sub.started_at`.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
  WARNING: a recent task that relied on this note failed a related review check.
